recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It is a narrow, non-substantive link-target correction on the active RESTful API page and does not require additional work-group review.
issue_request: FHIR-16370 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core HTTP issue requesting that the JSON Patch pointer on the RESTful API patch section change from jsonpatch.com to https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902, matching the official RFC treatment already used for XML Patch.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by svn/git commit c72549f8dbbb9001c72f2c07aeec257b024b476f (svn r14167), which changed the main JSON Patch document link in source/http.html from http://jsonpatch.com/ to an RFC 6902 URL. The current source retained that main RFC link.
additional_context: A later Published/Persuasive issue, FHIR-29715, added the JSON Patch test-operation 422 clarification to the same patch section in commit 639dbcd2848776be444488fe66b23438c581256d, but the new sentence linked JSON Patch test back to http://jsonpatch.com/#test. Community searches found no Zulip or Confluence evidence that would argue against using the RFC for that reference.
reconciliation: Changed source/http.html so the JSON Patch test-operation link points to https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902#section-4.6. This preserves the FHIR-29715 422 behavior while completing the stable RFC-link intent of FHIR-16370 for the current patch section.
source_changes: source/http.html: changed the JSON Patch test-operation href from http://jsonpatch.com/#test to https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902#section-4.6.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-29715 added the JSON Patch test-operation sentence that later reintroduced a jsonpatch.com link in the same patch section; its 422 behavior remains unchanged.
